commands.command: if command -v dpkg-query >/dev/null; then echo "Installed packages: $(dpkg-query -W 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; l=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\n' 2>/dev/null); elif command -v rpm >/dev/null; then echo "Installed packages: $(rpm -qa | wc -l)"; l=$(rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\n'); elif command -v opkg >/dev/null; then echo "Installed packages: $(opkg list-installed | wc -l)"; l=$(opkg list-installed | cut -d' ' -f1); else echo "no package database"; exit 0; fi; echo "Development, debug or desktop packages:"; grep -iE '^(xserver|xorg|gnome|kde|xfce|gcc|g\+\+|make|gdb|strace|ltrace|tcpdump|telnet|valgrind)' <<< "$l" | head -n 30;
commands.Name: Only required packages installed
commands.Description: recommended package management : N'installer que les paquets strictement nécessaires | ANSII R58 |

commands.command: if [ ! -d /etc/apt ]; then echo "no apt configuration"; elif grep -rqsiE 'trusted=yes|allow-insecure=yes|AllowUnauthenticated|AllowInsecureRepositories' /etc/apt/; then echo "vulnerable"; else echo "robust"; fi;
commands.Name: APT trusted repositories
commands.Description: recommended package management : Utiliser des dépôts de paquets de confiance | ANSII R59 |

commands.command: echo "Configured repositories:"; grep -rhsE '^[[:space:]]*(deb |URIs:|baseurl|src/gz|src )' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ /etc/yum.repos.d/ /etc/opkg/ 2>/dev/null | head -n 30;
commands.Name: Hardened package repositories
commands.Description: recommended package management : Utiliser des dépôts de paquets durcis | ANSII R60 |

commands.command: if [ -r /var/os-version ]; then d=$(grep Date /var/os-version | cut -d ':' -f2 | cut -d ' ' -f2); t=$(date -d "$d" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $(( $(date +%s) - t )) -gt 2073700 ]; then echo "vulnerable version needs update"; else echo "robust update"; fi; elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then n=$(apt-get -s upgrade 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^Inst .*-security'); if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then echo "robust update"; else echo "vulnerable version needs update"; fi; else echo "update status unknown"; fi;
commands.Name: System up to date
commands.Description: recommended package management : Effectuer des mises à jour régulières | ANSII R61 |

commands.command: if ! command -v systemctl >/dev/null; then echo "systemctl not found"; elif systemctl list-units --type=service,socket --state=active --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qiE 'rpc|nfs|portmap|statd|avahi|zeroconf|dhcp|cups|hald|consolekit|polkit|display-manager|gdm|lightdm|sddm|xorg'; then echo "vulnerable"; else echo "robust"; fi;
commands.Name: Unneeded network services
commands.Description: recommended services : Désactiver les services non nécessaires | ANSII R62 |

commands.command: listen() { if command -v ss >/dev/null; then ss -Htulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $5, $7}'; else netstat -tulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '/^(tcp|udp)/ {print $1, $4, ($1 ~ /^tcp/ ? $7 : $6)}'; fi; }; command -v ss >/dev/null || command -v netstat >/dev/null || { echo "no socket tool available (ss or netstat)"; exit 0; }; echo "Listening services (review their enabled features):"; listen | awk '{p=$1; sub(/6$/, "", p); n=$3; sub(/^users:\(\("/, "", n); sub(/".*/, "", n); sub(/^[0-9]+\//, "", n); sub(/:.*/, "", n); port=$2; sub(/.*:/, "", port); if (p == "udp" && port+0 >= 32768) next; print p, $2, n}' | sort -u;
commands.Name: Non-essential service features
commands.Description: recommended services : Désactiver les fonctionnalités des services non essentielles | ANSII R63 |

commands.command: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null; then echo "Services running as root:"; for u in $(systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -vE '^(sshd@|user@|user-runtime-dir@|getty@|serial-getty@)'); do s=$(systemctl show -p User --value "$u" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$s" ] || [ "$s" = root ]; then echo "  $u"; fi; done; else echo "Processes running as root:"; ps -eo user=,ppid=,pid=,comm= | awk '$1=="root" && $2!=2 && $3!=2 {print "  "$4}' | sort -u; fi; if command -v getcap >/dev/null; then echo "Files with capabilities:"; getcap -r /usr /bin /sbin /opt 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n 30; fi;
commands.Name: Service privileges
commands.Description: recommended services : Configurer les privilèges des services | ANSII R64 |

commands.command: if ! command -v systemd-analyze >/dev/null; then echo "systemd-analyze not available"; exit 0; fi; l=$(systemd-analyze security --no-pager 2>/dev/null | awk '$(NF-1)=="UNSAFE" || $NF=="UNSAFE" {print $1}' | head -n 15 | tr '\n' ' '); if [ -z "$l" ]; then echo "robust"; else echo "vulnerable: $l"; fi;
commands.Name: Services sandboxed (no UNSAFE unit)
commands.Description: recommended services : Cloisonner les services | ANSII R65 |

commands.command: o=$(for t in docker podman lxc-start containerd runc crun virsh qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-aarch64; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null && echo "installed: $t"; done; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'docker|containerd|podman|lxc|libvirt|qemu' | awk '{print "running: "$1}'); if [ -z "$o" ]; then echo "not applicable"; else echo "$o"; fi;
commands.Name: Sandboxing components hardened
commands.Description: recommended services : Durcir les composants de cloisonnement | ANSII R66 |

commands.command: if ! grep -qsE '^[^#]*pam_(ldap|sss)\.so' /etc/pam.d/*; then echo "not applicable"; exit 0; fi; if grep -qsiE '^[[:space:]]*(ldap_uri[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*ldaps://|ldap_id_use_start_tls[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true|ssl[[:space:]]+(on|start_tls)|uri[[:space:]]+ldaps://)' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf /etc/sssd/conf.d/*.conf /etc/nslcd.conf /etc/ldap.conf /etc/pam_ldap.conf; then echo "robust"; else echo "vulnerable"; fi;
commands.Name: Remote PAM authentication over TLS
commands.Description: recommended authentication : Sécuriser les authentifications distantes par PAM | ANSII R67 |

commands.command: l=$(grep -shE '^[^#]*password.*pam_unix\.so' /etc/pam.d/common-password /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth | head -n1); if grep -qw yescrypt <<< "$l"; then echo "robust"; elif grep -qw sha512 <<< "$l" && [ "$(grep -oE 'rounds=[0-9]+' <<< "$l" | cut -d= -f2)" -ge 65536 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "robust"; else echo "vulnerable"; fi;
commands.Name: PAM sha512 rounds
commands.Description: recommended authentication : Protéger les mots de passe stockés | ANSII R68.1 |

commands.command: if [ ! -r /etc/shadow ]; then echo "shadow not readable"; exit 0; fi; l=$(awk -F: '{h=$2; sub(/^!+/, "", h)} h == "" || h ~ /^\*/ || h ~ /^\$(y|gy|7)\$/ {next} h ~ /^\$6\$rounds=[0-9]+\$/ {split(h, a, /[=$]/); if (a[4] >= 65536) next} {print $1}' /etc/shadow | head -n 15 | tr '\n' ' '); if [ -z "$l" ]; then echo "robust"; else echo "vulnerable: $l"; fi;
commands.Name: Stored password hashes strong
commands.Description: recommended authentication : Protéger les mots de passe stockés | ANSII R68.2 |

commands.command: if ! grep -qsE '^[[:space:]]*(passwd|group|shadow):.*[[:space:]](ldap|sss)([[:space:]]|$)' /etc/nsswitch.conf; then echo "not applicable"; exit 0; fi; if grep -qsiE '^[[:space:]]*(ldap_uri[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*ldaps://|ldap_id_use_start_tls[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true|ssl[[:space:]]+(on|start_tls)|uri[[:space:]]+ldaps://)' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf /etc/sssd/conf.d/*.conf /etc/nslcd.conf /etc/ldap.conf; then echo "robust"; else echo "vulnerable"; fi;
commands.Name: Remote user database over TLS
commands.Description: recommended authentication : Sécuriser les accès aux bases utilisateur distantes | ANSII R69 |

commands.command: o=$(grep -hsiE '^[[:space:]]*(binddn|rootbinddn|ldap_default_bind_dn|bind_dn)' /etc/nslcd.conf /etc/sssd/sssd.conf /etc/sssd/conf.d/*.conf /etc/ldap.conf /etc/libnss-ldap.conf); if [ -z "$o" ]; then echo "not applicable"; else echo "$o"; fi;
commands.Name: Directory system/admin accounts separated
commands.Description: recommended authentication : Séparer les comptes système et d'administrateur de l'annuaire | ANSII R70 |

commands.command: if { systemctl is-active -q systemd-journald 2>/dev/null || pgrep -x 'rsyslogd|syslog-ng|syslogd' >/dev/null; }; then echo "found"; else echo "not found"; fi;
commands.Name: Logging service running
commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Mettre en place un système de journalisation | ANSII R71 |

commands.command: echo "Log files and owners (rotated files excluded):"; find /var/log -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%M %u:%g %f\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '\.[0-9]+(\.gz)?$|\.(old|gz)$' | sort; echo "journald storage:"; grep -hsE '^[[:space:]]*Storage=' /etc/systemd/journald.conf /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/*.conf /usr/lib/systemd/journald.conf.d/*.conf || echo "  default";
commands.Name: Dedicated service logs
commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Mettre en place des journaux d'activité de service dédiés | ANSII R72 |

commands.command: if pgrep -x auditd >/dev/null; then echo "found"; else echo "not found"; fi;
commands.Name: auditd running
commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Journaliser l'activité système avec auditd | ANSII R73.1 |

commands.command: if auditctl -l 2>/dev/null | grep -qE -- '^-w /etc/? -p [rwx]*w[rwx]*a'; then echo "found"; else echo "not found"; fi;
commands.Name: auditd watches /etc
commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Journaliser l'activité système avec auditd | ANSII R73.2 |

commands.command: r=$(auditctl -l 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$r" ]; then echo "no audit rules"; exit 0; fi; miss=""; grep -qE -- '-w (/usr)?/s?bin/(insmod|modprobe|rmmod|kmod) -p [rwa]*x' <<< "$r" || miss="$miss kmod-exec"; s="mount umount2 ptrace prctl unlink rmdir rename creat open openat truncate ftruncate init_module delete_module finit_module"; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|i?86) s="$s ioperm modify_ldt";; esac; for x in $s; do grep -qE -- "-S ([a-z0-9_]+,)*$x(,|[[:space:]]|$)" <<< "$r" || miss="$miss $x"; done; grep -E 'openat' <<< "$r" | grep -q 'EACCES' || miss="$miss open-EACCES"; if [ -z "$miss" ]; then echo "found"; else echo "missing:$miss"; fi;
commands.Name: auditd rules of the ANSSI example
commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Journaliser l'activité système avec auditd | ANSII R73.3 |

commands.command: if [ "$(auditctl -s 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="enabled" {print $2}')" = 2 ]; then echo "found"; else echo "not found"; fi;
commands.Name: auditd configuration immutable
commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Journaliser l'activité système avec auditd | ANSII R73.4 |

commands.Description: recommended logging and integrity : Durcir le service de messagerie locale | ANSII R74 |

commands.command: if ! command -v sendmail >/dev/null && [ ! -e /etc/aliases ]; then echo "not applicable"; exit 0; fi; if grep -qsE '^[[:space:]]*root[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]' /etc/aliases; then echo "found"; else echo "not found"; fi;

commands.command: if { { dmsetup table 2>/dev/null | grep -qw verity || grep -qE 'roothash=|systemd\.verity|dm-mod\.create=[^ ]*verity' /proc/cmdline; } || ls /var/lib/aide/aide.db* >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -d /var/lib/tripwire ]; }; then echo "found"; else echo "not found"; fi;

commands.command: if { dmsetup table 2>/dev/null | grep -qw verity || grep -qE 'roothash=|systemd\.verity|dm-mod\.create=[^ ]*verity' /proc/cmdline; }; then echo "found"; exit 0; fi; db=$(ls /var/lib/aide/aide.db* 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z "$db" ]; then echo "not found"; exit 0; fi; m=$(df -P "$db" | awk 'NR==2 {print $6}'); if awk -v m="$m" '$2==m {o=$4} END {exit !(o ~ /(^|,)ro(,|$)/)}' /proc/self/mounts; then echo "found"; else echo "database on writable storage"; fi;
commands.Name: Integrity database protected

commands.command: listen() { if command -v ss >/dev/null; then ss -Htulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $5, $7}'; else netstat -tulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '/^(tcp|udp)/ {print $1, $4, ($1 ~ /^tcp/ ? $7 : $6)}'; fi; }; command -v ss >/dev/null || command -v netstat >/dev/null || { echo "no socket tool available (ss or netstat)"; exit 0; }; echo "Listening services and the user they run as:"; listen | grep -oE 'pid=[0-9]+|[[:space:]][0-9]+/' | tr -dc '0-9\n' | sort -u | while read -r p; do printf '  %-12s %s\n' "$(ps -o user= -p "$p")" "$(ps -o comm= -p "$p")"; done | sort -u;
commands.Name: Network services partitioned

commands.command: listen() { if command -v ss >/dev/null; then ss -Htulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $5, $7}'; else netstat -tulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '/^(tcp|udp)/ {print $1, $4, ($1 ~ /^tcp/ ? $7 : $6)}'; fi; }; command -v ss >/dev/null || command -v netstat >/dev/null || { echo "no socket tool available (ss or netstat)"; exit 0; }; echo "Services listening on non-loopback addresses:"; listen | awk '{p=$1; sub(/6$/, "", p); n=$3; sub(/^users:\(\("/, "", n); sub(/".*/, "", n); sub(/^[0-9]+\//, "", n); sub(/:.*/, "", n); port=$2; sub(/.*:/, "", port); if (p == "udp" && port+0 >= 32768) next; print p, $2, n}' | sort -u | awk '$2 !~ /^(127\.|\[::1\]|::1:|\[::ffff:127\.|::ffff:127\.)/ {print "  "$0}';
commands.Name: Exposed services hardened and monitored
commands.Description: recommended network services : Durcir et surveiller les services exposés | ANSII R79 |

commands.command: listen() { if command -v ss >/dev/null; then ss -Htulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $5, $7}'; else netstat -tulpn 2>/dev/null | awk '/^(tcp|udp)/ {print $1, $4, ($1 ~ /^tcp/ ? $7 : $6)}'; fi; }; command -v ss >/dev/null || command -v netstat >/dev/null || { echo "no socket tool available (ss or netstat)"; exit 0; }; l=$(listen | awk '$2 !~ /^(127\.|\[::1\]|::1:|\[::ffff:127\.|::ffff:127\.)/ {print $2"("$3")"}' | grep -vE '"sshd"|/sshd' | head -n 15 | tr '\n' ' '); if [ -z "$l" ]; then echo "robust"; else echo "vulnerable: $l"; fi;
commands.Name: Listening services besides sshd
